newsitem.title: USA: Schweitzer-Mauduit starts up paper machine.
newsitem.headline: Schweitzer-Mauduit starts up paper machine.

text.p: Schweitzer-Mauduit International Inc Monday said it started up a new long fiber paper machine at its Papeteries de Mauduit subsidiary in Quimperle, France.

The new paper machine and associated converting equipment cost $24 million and will add approximately 6,000 metric tonnes of annual capacity for the production of long fiber products such as highly porous tobacco-related papers, alkaline battery separator paper, liners for vacuum cleaner bags, and overlay papers, the company said.
